name: shell-cup
description: A cylinder 20 mm round and 50 mm tall, hollowed out to 3 mm walls with its top open: a cup. Worked out by hand: volume pi (20^2 x 50 - 17^2 x 47) = 20159.600058 mm^3; area: outside wall 2 pi 20 x 50, bottom pi 20^2, the rim pi (20^2 - 17^2), inside wall 2 pi 17 x 47, inside floor pi 17^2: 13816.724490 mm^2.
